Topics, the \"I\'m struggling\" flow and saved verses are coming next. Everything here will work offline and stay private.
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

An account is optional. Protection, your limits and Scripture work without one, and without internet. An account lets you invite someone you trust to support you, and you choose exactly what they can see.
This is the only name a partner sees. Not your email.

What is sent to Identity and stored: your email, the nickname you choose, and the model, Android version and app version of this phone. Never the websites you visit, your searches, or your Scripture notes. You can change your nickname at any time, and deleting your account will be possible from this screen in an upcoming update.
I understand what is sent and stored, and I agree.
Account created. Open the email we sent you and tap the link, then sign in here.
This phone is registered to your account.
This phone is not registered yet.
Nobody supports you yet. A partner is someone you trust who will see only what you choose below.
Whether protection is on, off or interrupted
How many sites were blocked each day (a number only)
When a protection setting is changed
They see your nickname, never your email, and never the names of websites. Sharing starts in a coming update; your choices are saved now and you can change them any time.
Invite a partner: Identity makes a one-time code that you send them. They install Identity, create an account, and enter the code on this screen. You can have up to 3 partners.
You have 3 partners, the most allowed. End a connection to invite someone else.
It works once, until %1$s. It is shown only now: if you lose it, cancel it below and make a new one.
I would like you to be my accountability partner on Identity. Install Identity, create an account, open the Partner tab and enter this code: %1$s. It works once and expires in 48 hours.
You are not supporting anyone yet.
They choose what you can see.
Did someone send you an invitation code? Enter it here to become their partner. They will choose what you can see, and either of you can end it at any time.

While protection is on, Identity always blocks adult websites, X and Reddit (websites, apps and posts shown on other sites), and the pictures in Google, Bing and DuckDuckGo image results. Normal search, YouTube in Restricted Mode, Gmail and Maps keep working.
Add websites or words you want blocked too. You can undo a new block for 10 minutes, in case of a typo. After that it stays.
For example example.com. Its whole site is blocked.
That doesn\'t look like a website name. Try something like example.com.
Block a word in site names
Blocks every site whose name contains it: casino blocks bestcasino.net. 4 letters or more. Short words can block innocent sites.
Use one word of 4 or more letters or numbers, with no spaces or dots.
You\'ve reached the limit of 500 blocks.

Choose how long TikTok may be used each day. When the time is used up, TikTok is covered with a reminder page and its servers are blocked until tomorrow. You can lower the limit at any time. A higher limit only starts tomorrow.
Identity needs Usage access to count the time TikTok is open. It only sees how long TikTok is open, and nothing leaves your phone.
To show the reminder page on top of TikTok, Identity needs permission to display over other apps. Without it, TikTok is still blocked when the time is up.
No limit set yet. TikTok is not restricted.
Time limits only work while protection is on.
TikTok time is up for today
You chose this limit yourself. It resets tomorrow.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control.
Takes you out of YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels. It only looks at YouTube and Instagram, only checks whether Shorts or Reels is on screen, and does not read, save or send anything.
Shorts and Reels are blocked by Identity
Identity can take you out of Shorts and Reels, back to the app\'s home screen, while the rest of YouTube and Instagram keeps working. You can open the app again straight away.

To do this, Identity uses Android\'s Accessibility Service, which lets an app see what is on the screen. Identity only looks at YouTube and Instagram, and only checks whether the Shorts or Reels screen is showing. It does not read what you type or what is on the page, and it does not save or send anything. You can turn it off at any time in Settings, Accessibility.
On. Shorts and Reels are blocked.
Interrupted. Protection is meant to be on but isn\'t running. Tap Turn on.
Your phone is set to bypass Identity
Private DNS is set to a custom provider, so web lookups go around Identity and nothing is blocked. Open Settings, Connections, More connection settings, Private DNS, and choose Automatic.
Keep protection from being turned off by accident

In Android\'s VPN settings, tap the gear next to Identity and turn on Always-on VPN. Leave Block connections without VPN off: Identity only filters web lookups, so that setting would cut your internet.
Identity stopped answering web lookups, so websites may not load. Turn protection off and on again.
Identity cannot reach its filtering service. Check your internet connection.
Private DNS is set to a custom provider, so web lookups go around Identity. See the card below.
Kept on this phone for 30 days, then deleted. It records only what protection did and when, never what you browse.
Protection turned off in Android settings or by another VPN

The list that came with the app: %1$s sites.
You already have the newest list.

Something on this phone tried to use its own encrypted DNS service, for example Chrome\'s Use secure DNS, and Identity stopped it. That app may not load pages until you turn the setting off (in Chrome: Settings, Privacy and security, Use secure DNS, With your current service provider).
An app or browser setting tried to use its own encrypted DNS service and was stopped
